content.short: Origin Dollar is the first stablecoin to earn a yield from your wallet.
content.description: Origin Dollar streamlines DeFi by removing the need for staking or lock-ups. Hold OUSD in any Ethereum wallet and watch your balance increase every day. This approach makes interacting with DeFi more approachable, letting users participate without the traditional barriers of locking assets or earning through complex yield strategies. With OUSD, your exposure to DeFi can rise over time simply by holding the token. That means there are no staking schedules or lock-up requirements to manage.
